Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Thanks for joining. Tell me about how energy bills work in your household.

Speaker: Participant
Text: I rent with two others, and the bill is in my name, so I split it with them every quarter.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Tell me about the last time you split it.

Speaker: Participant
Text: In September. The bill was estimated and much higher than the one before, and my housemates thought I'd got the sums wrong. I had to show them the bill in the app to prove it.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: What did you do about the estimate?

Speaker: Participant
Text: I sent a reading that evening. I'd missed the reminder because it came on a Saturday morning when I was out. It took over a week before the corrected bill turned up, and I had to explain it all again to the house.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: How do you feel about the app overall?

Speaker: Participant
Text: It's fine. It does what it needs to.
